141-3967-4454.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3967-4454.description:
Cast Bond of Revival by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Bond of Revival.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Naru Meha, Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Bond of Revival
Resolve the Bond of Revival copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3532-3836-5078-7811.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

372-673-2781.manaNeeded: {5}{U}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-673-2781.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Planar Incision by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Felidar Guardian to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Felidar Guardian's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1169-2446-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1169-2446-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Living Hive, triggering Breath of Fury and Living Hive.
Resolve the Living Hive trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1274-5870-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-5870-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}
Repeat from step 2.

1628-3490-5147-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
1628-3490-5147-7426.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Berta triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat

4090-7407.easyPrerequisites: Inviolability and Pariah are attached to the same creature.
4090-7407.description:
Whenever damage would be dealt to you, Pariah causes that damage to be redirected to the creature it is attached to.
Since Inviolability grants an ability to the creature preventing damage being dealt to it, no damage is dealt to you or to that creature.

1806-2060-2445-5686-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Branching Evolution.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

6747-7182-7252.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four artifacts.
6747-7182-7252.description:
Cast Grave Sifter for its evoke cost by paying {0} due to Sami.
When Grave Sifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Grave Sifter.
When Grave Sifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Grave Sifter with haste.
When the Grave Sifter token enters, it triggers, returning Grave Sifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1020-2350-2866-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Stone Calendar.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Stone Calendar.
Repeat.

369-2730-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3129-3899-4885.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1409-3128-3129.description:
Activate Skullport Merchant by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Skullport Merchant enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Skullport Merchant.
Resolve the Skullport Merchant trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

236-539-3899-4552-6753.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Animating Faerie // Bring to Life.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-2841-3703-6158.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Blighted Woodland.
1479-2841-3703-6158.description:
Fetch a land using Blighted Woodland.
When the fetched land enters, Sporemound and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sporemound trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sporemound triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

967-3809-6753-6797-7087.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1274-5641-6752.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-5641-6752.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

813-3556-4872.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Time Warp and Flicker.
813-3556-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp and Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

710-3055-5147.notablePrerequisites: Gift of Immortality attached to Danitha.
710-3055-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1247-4747-5963.notablePrerequisites:
You had a creature with power 2 or greater enter the battlefield this turn.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1247-4747-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Alena's ability by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

678-4192-5659-5686-5753.description:
Discard Circling Vultures from your hand using its static ability.
Because Circling Vultures is a Lhurgoyf due to Ashes of the Fallen, Disa the Restless's first ability triggers, putting Circling Vultures from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Circling Vultures.
When Circling Vultures dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Circling Vultures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

413-1778-5220-5683.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Memnite.
When Memnite dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Memnite from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Memnite and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
When Memnite enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

240-526-2921.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Egg creature tokens.
240-526-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing an Egg.
When the Egg dies, Atla Palani triggers, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, if it has power 4 or greater, Life Finds a Way triggers, creating a copy of an Egg token you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
240-526-2921.notes: This combo will only fetch every creature in your library if all creatures have power 4 or greater. You may use additional Egg tokens to grab as many creatures as possible.

1115-3259-5768.notablePrerequisites:
Origin of the Hidden Ones has exactly two lore counters on it.
You control at least one Assassin that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-3259-5768.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
Origin of the Hidden Ones' third chapter ability triggers, causing you to create an Assassin token whenever an Assassin attacks this turn and sacrifice Origin of the Hidden Ones.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached, and at least one Assassin if the creature with Breath of Fury attached isn't an Assassin, as attackers.
Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

539-2034-5003-5702.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ashaya, adding {C}{C}.
When Ashaya dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Ashaya from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Ashaya enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, choosing not to pay and create a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
If you control a nontoken creature that has haste, you may instead sacrifice it, and then tap it each iteration to get infinite green mana and colorless mana.

4518-4772-5554.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure or Gold token.
4518-4772-5554.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {1}{W}.
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two token copies of any Treasure or Gold token you control.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, or two Golds by sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

1946-2512-4361.description:
Activate Nomads en-Kor's first ability by paying {0}, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, causing itself to get +0/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Nomads en-Kor ability, causing the next one damage dealt to Nomads en-Kor this turn to be dealt to Daru Spiritualist instead.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Miren's second ability by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Daru Spiritualist, causing you to gain life equal to Daru Spiritualist's toughness.

57-914-2178-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon.
Feldon does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
57-914-2178-4050.description:
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {1}.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, Feldon triggers, untapping Feldon.
Repeat.

3352-3492-3609.notablePrerequisites: Coretapper does not have summoning sickness.
3352-3492-3609.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Cast Disturbed Burial with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to your hand and returning Disturbed Burial to your hand.
Cast Coretapper by paying {2}.
Repeat each turn.

1235-1953-2105.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {1}{R}, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr creature token, then choosing to have all tokens you control become copies of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare one of the Combat Celebrant copy as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant copy triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

1309-2104-2665.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Salvager of Secrets.
1309-2104-2665.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets.
When the token Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
